propositions: Store requires a persistent mapping of tracker projects to repos, shared across all repos using a single bridge state directory, to prevent multi-repo fetches from diffing each other's projects as remote deletions.

The projects mapping must be surfaced as read-write operations (list, set, remove) through three independent surfaces: CLI subcommands, library functions, and MCP tools, all reading and writing the same canonical record.

resolve_project implements a tri-state rule: absent ticket field returns legacy_default, explicit empty string returns None (not synced), and project key returns itself; callers treat None as no mutation.
An absent projects.json record is legal and reads as empty mapping with None legacy_default; a malformed record raises; ensure operations seed the record at init, fsck repair, or MCP boot.
The set verb requires --repos argument (non-zero exit if omitted); --repos "" explicitly stores empty list; set on existing key replaces rather than merges repos list (idempotent).
Pinned help text in bridge.txt and argparse metavar verb set must both name projects verb, and mapping writes must leave bindings.json and prev_snapshot.json byte-identical.
